rows.text: **Avio Smart Market Stack** (formerly Bartronics India) -- board approves a Rights Issue of up to Rs 49 cr; Rs 14 cr of the proceeds earmarked for a subscription investment in Ampivo Smart Technologies (AgriTech, Agri Kisan Setu platform); terms and record date not yet fixed.
